releaseNotes:
- SOS now fires in under 2 seconds: your request is sent instantly with the last known location, and updates automatically
- Automatic retry: if your network drops mid-SOS, the app tries once more on its own
- No more endless loading: every screen now gives up gracefully with a clear message and a Retry button
- Errors are now friendly and translated: network, timeout, sign-in and server problems all show simple messages in English or Urdu
- Images (photos in requests and profiles) load much faster - saved on your phone after first download
- Privacy section rewritten in plain language with a new Notifications explanation
- Faster app startup and smoother scrolling
- Fixed: language chooser sheet could overlap on small screens
- Fixed: unapproved/failed requests could leave the screen stuck on a skeleton loader
